user: I have an ethical objection to using beauty products that contain animal-derived ingredients like beeswax or lanolin.
assistant:  It's great to hear that you are conscious about the ingredients in your beauty products and have ethical objections to using those that contain animal-derived ingredients like beeswax or lanolin. Many people share your concerns and prefer to use cruelty-free and vegan beauty products.

To avoid using beauty products that contain animal-derived ingredients, you can look for products that are certified vegan or cruelty-free. There are many reputable organizations that certify products as vegan or cruelty-free, such as PETA, Leaping Bunny, and Choose Cruelty-Free. These organizations have strict standards and only certify products that meet their criteria.

When shopping for beauty products, you can look for the certifying organization's logo on the packaging or check the product's ingredient list. If you're unsure about an ingredient, you can look it up online or contact the manufacturer to ask if it's derived from animals.
